scene: You step off the glass tram into the humid Night Greenhouse Market.
picture: Flat side-view along a tiled greenhouse floor. On the far left sits a bamboo juice bar with glowing bottles. Left of centre, the player stands pushing his bicycle with plant crate beside the open glass tram. Centre holds a giant carved pumpkin on straw. Far right, a round copper misting robot rolls past.
